description: This file defines a utility enum 'OpenClawKitResources' that manages locating and accessing the resource bundle for the OpenClawKit module in various runtime environments, such as packaged apps and SwiftPM development/testing. It contains logic for attempting multiple bundle lookup strategies to reliably find the resource bundle, including inside the main app bundle, via SwiftPM's module bundle, and falling back gracefully.

classes.name: BundleLocator
classes.description: A helper class used solely for obtaining a bundle reference via 'Bundle(for:)' within the bundle lookup strategy.

methods.name: locateBundle
methods.description: Public static method that attempts to locate and return the resource bundle for the OpenClawKit module by checking multiple potential locations.

methods.name: loadModuleBundleSafely
methods.description: Private static method that cautiously attempts to load the module's bundle without risking a crash, by checking common resource locations and walking directory hierarchies.
